note: Hand-transcribed from the printed spell headers and text of SRD 5.2.1, 'Spell Descriptions', pp. 107-164; never generated from content/data. Page is the printed page of the spell heading. Components, castingTime, range and duration are as printed. Phrases are verbatim runs of the description.

spells.name: Acid Splash
phrases: You create an acidic bubble at a point within range
where it explodes in a 5-foot-radius Sphere
must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 Acid damage

spells.name: Bless
spells.components: V, S, M (a Holy Symbol worth 5+ GP)
phrases: You bless up to three creatures within range
the target adds 1d4 to the attack roll or save
spells.scalingPhrase: one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1

spells.name: Burning Hands
phrases: A thin sheet of flames shoots forth from you
Each creature in a 15-foot Cone makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 Fire damage
Flammable objects in the Cone that aren’t being worn or carried start burning.
spells.scalingPhrase: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1

spells.name: Chromatic Orb
spells.components: V, S, M (a diamond worth 50+ GP)
phrases: Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder for the type of orb you create
the target takes 3d8 damage of the chosen type
the orb leaps to a different target of your choice within 30 feet of the target
The orb can’t leap again unless you cast the spell with a level 2+ spell slot.
spells.scalingPhrase: The orb can leap a maximum number of times equal to the level of the slot expended

spells.name: Command
phrases: You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range
Choose the command from these options:
ending its turn if it moves within 5 feet of you
The target has the Prone condition and then ends its turn.
the target doesn’t move and takes no action or Bonus Action
spells.scalingPhrase: You can affect one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1

spells.name: Cure Wounds
phrases: A creature you touch regains a number of Hit Points equal to 2d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.
spells.scalingPhrase: The healing increases by 2d8 for each spell slot level above 1

spells.name: Divine Smite
spells.castingTime: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
phrases: The target takes an extra 2d8 Radiant damage from the attack.
The damage increases by 1d8 if the target is a Fiend or an Undead.
spells.scalingPhrase: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1

spells.name: Fog Cloud
phrases: You create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of fog centered on a point within range.
The Sphere is Heavily Obscured.
a strong wind (such as one created by Gust of Wind) disperses it
spells.scalingPhrase: The fog’s radius increases by 20 feet for each spell slot level above 1

spells.name: Hunter’s Mark
phrases: You magically mark one creature you can see within range as your quarry.
you deal an extra 1d6 Force damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack roll
Advantage on any Wisdom (Perception or Survival) check you make to find it.
you can take a Bonus Action to move the mark to a new creature you can see within range
spells.scalingPhrase: level 3–4 (up to 8 hours) or 5+ (up to 24 hours)

spells.name: Protection from Evil and Good
spells.components: V, S, M (a flask of Holy Water worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes)
phrases: one willing creature you touch is protected against creatures that are Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, or Undead
Creatures of those types have Disadvantage on attack rolls against the target.
can’t be possessed by or gain the Charmed or Frightened conditions from them
the target has Advantage on any new saving throw against the relevant effect.

spells.name: Ray of Frost
phrases: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range.
it takes 1d8 Cold damage, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

spells.name: Ray of Sickness
phrases: You shoot a greenish ray at a creature within range.
the target takes 2d8 Poison damage and has the Poisoned condition until the end of your next turn.
spells.scalingPhrase: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1

spells.name: Shield of Faith
phrases: A shimmering field surrounds a creature of your choice within range, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

spells.name: Shocking Grasp
phrases: Lightning springs from you to a creature that you try to touch.
Make a melee spell attack against the target.
it can’t make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.components: V, S, M (a pinch of sand or rose petals)
phrases: Each creature of your choice in a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range
have the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn
the target has the Unconscious condition for the duration
Creatures that don’t sleep, such as elves, or that have Immunity to the Exhaustion condition automatically succeed on saves against this spell.

spells.name: Speak with Animals
phrases: you can comprehend and verbally communicate with Beasts
the Influence action’s skill options
including whatever it has perceived within the past day.
